items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: I'd get the music, Paul Denniger used to write -- he was a writer and he used to write bits

ctx.x: Tell me some of the people that used to be down there. You would build a show around Eddie South. Who the -- the violin was Eddie South.

Yeah, the manager -- I mean the producer, he'd have the -- he'd have something in mind and he'd tell us to get together and make up something, see and we'd make -- I'd get the music, Paul Denniger used to write -- he was a writer and he used to write bits, Porter Grainger, remember Porter Grainger?
